caption: The drawing consists of a single, central object depicted in graphite pencil on a beige or off-white background. The object is a container with a rounded, bulbous body that tapers at the neck and sits on a stepped, round pedestal base. The container has a lid with a domed shape, topped by a small ornamental finial. The lid features a decorative pattern of crosshatched lines and evenly spaced holes, suggesting it is perforated. Surrounding the main drawing is a lightly sketched rectangular border. In the bottom right corner, there is a smaller inset drawing of the same object, rendered with dimensions marked beside it (7 1/4 inches tall and 3 1/4 inches wide). The only visible writing is near the lower left, possibly a signature. The entire image is monochromatic, using only shades of gray.
title: Silver Shaker
